title: VR Far Cry 3 after one evening with AI
author: mr_joshua74
selftext:
I basically told Astra to use Godot to make a VR version of Far Cry 3- an outpost with guards that patrol. I said to make the guards legless potatoes with floating hands and to use Quake 2 style graphics. What it created was not great, but it had all the bones of what I was going for. It made some terrible 3d models despite my giving it clear concept art and directions. The initial product looked like garbage.

The amazing thing though is that I was able to open up Blender and fix or make new models and it integrated them into the project on the fly. The amount that I was able to do in just a few hours has blown me away. 

I downloaded a gun sound effect, modeled the gun in two parts, and explained how I wanted the slide to work. I told it to add muzzle flash and an effect where the bullet hits. The original product had a solid flat grey box as the pistol and it shot a noiseless laser beam. After one prompt with my new assets the gun was working exactly like I asked.  

The AI is not a super genius who can do everything, but as a partner it has been able to flawlessly implement or fix things step by step as we work on the project together. 

This is something I never in my wildest dreams would have imagined to be possible.
